chunks.title: Ziraat Bankası (Ziraat Bankası) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Ziraat Bankası is a Turkish State Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Main Partner (Culture & Civilization Partner); COP31 panel on green SME, CBAM exporter & climate-smart agricultural financing. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: $2.9B sustainability-linked syndicated financing in 2026 + $2B additional planned during COP31; Carbon Border Reduction Package (20% emission cut) & Green Export Loan. Source verification: https://www.dailysabah.com/business/energy/turkish-state-banks-expand-green-financing-for-smes-at-cop31.

chunks.title: Ziraat Bankası Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Ziraat Bankası provides the following climate financing instruments: Carbon Border (CBAM) Reduction Loan, Green Export Loan (SME), Organized Industrial Zone (OIZ) Green Package, Climate-Smart Agricultural Loan. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 50,000 to USD 100,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: SME, Large Corporate, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Agricultural Cooperative.

chunks.title: Ziraat Bankası Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Ziraat Bankası: Sustainable Agriculture & Water, EU CBAM Export Compliance, Industrial Decarbonization, SME Green Transition, Renewable Energy. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Ziraat Bankası Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Ziraat Bankası's application form: Turkish enterprise / farmer / OIZ registration (VKN/ÇKS); Target >=20% carbon footprint reduction (for Carbon Border Reduction Package); Export documentation (for Green Export Loan) or agricultural certification; Collateral or KGF guarantee package. Explicit exclusion rules: Environmentally prohibited activities; Unpermitted water extraction. Official application portal: https://www.ziraatbank.com.tr/en/our-bank/sustainability.

chunks.title: Ziraat Bankası Form Template: Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application
chunks.text: Ziraat Bankası uses the 'Turkish Commercial / State Bank Sustainable & Green Transformation Loan Application' workflow governed by BRSA (BDDK) Sustainable Banking Guidelines, Turkish Green Taxonomy & EU CBAM Readiness. Typical review timeline is 1–4 weeks (Branch/Corporate RM Intake -> Green Eligibility Check -> Credit Approval). Form sections required: 1. Applicant Identification, 2. Product Selection, 3. Green Technical Criteria, 4. Credit & Collateral, 5. Compliance, 6. Summary.
